issues.where: crop A, lower cloud belts straddling the terminator
issues.what: The fine cloud texture drops out into broad, soft brown bands with a brushed look, especially just inside the shadow.
issues.fix: Preserve low-contrast cloud structure through the lighting falloff instead of broadening or blurring the bands.

issues.where: crop L, blue polar cap and adjacent sunlit limb
issues.what: The blue cap resolves into smooth nested ovals with little internal texture, while the thin amber rim reads as a separate line outside the globe.
issues.fix: Break up the polar gradients with subtle cloud structure and blend the warm rim into the atmospheric falloff.

issues.where: crops U and V, broad foreground ring bands
issues.what: The bright tracks have a uniformly speckled, scratchy finish at native size, particularly along the dark gap.
issues.fix: Filter subpixel ring tracks and vary the particulate contrast across ring bands.

issues.where: crops W and X, lower-right sky beyond the ring shadow
issues.what: A straight, soft horizontal glow crosses the background stars and reads as a composited streak.
issues.fix: Remove the streak or reduce its contrast so it does not form a visible stripe in the sky.

issues.what: The illuminated face is nearly featureless and looks like a soft color gradient next to the sharper star field.
issues.fix: Keep the limb crisp and add restrained variation to the lit face without oversharpening it.

issues.where: near rings, lower left (crops D, G, T)
issues.what: bright single-pixel white and pink specks are scattered over the lit ring surface. They read as render noise or fireflies, not as ring particles
issues.fix: clamp or denoise specular samples on the ring shader, or raise samples so isolated hot pixels go away

issues.where: rings, left and lower arcs (crops O, U, T)
issues.what: the same hot-pixel sparkle sits on the ring bands, most clearly on the inner bright ring and the outer A ring
issues.fix: apply the same firefly clamp or denoise to the ring pass

issues.where: globe, lit hemisphere (crops P, K, D)
issues.what: at native size the cloud bands are soft and airbrushed, with almost no fine turbulence. The globe looks smooth and plastic next to the crisp rings
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution or sharper globe texture with small-scale storm and eddy detail in the bands

issues.where: foreground ring plane, lower right (crops E, W, X)
issues.what: the closest ring texture turns into a uniform, slightly mottled grain of parallel streaks. Up close it looks like stretched noise, not structured ringlets
issues.fix: add a near-field detail layer with finer ringlet structure and less directional stretching at grazing angles

issues.where: planet limb against the sky, upper left (crops L, A)
issues.what: the glow around the limb is a wide, even, warm halo that looks like a bloom glow on the layer, not atmosphere
issues.fix: narrow and weaken the limb bloom so the edge stays crisp, with only a thin atmospheric falloff

issues.what: the moon is a flat orange disc with a soft edge and no surface detail, so it reads as a placeholder sprite
issues.fix: give the moon real shading, a sharp limb and some albedo or surface detail

issues.where: beyond the outer ring, lower left (crops H, T)
issues.what: a faint thin arc runs through empty sky outside the main rings. It looks like a stray line or seam, not a deliberate faint ring
issues.fix: remove the arc, or make it read clearly as a faint outer ring with a consistent width and brightness

issues.where: upper right sky (crops C, M, N)
issues.what: the dark sky gradient is very smooth and slightly blocky in tone, with faint banding near the vignette
issues.fix: dither the background gradient and add faint dust or star density variation
